response.sql: WITH type_averages AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS type_average FROM Products GROUP BY production_type_code), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS overall_average FROM Products HAVING AVG(unit_price) IS NOT NULL), kept_types AS (SELECT t.production_type_code, t.type_average FROM type_averages t CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE t.type_average > b.overall_average), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(type_average) AS average_kept_type FROM kept_types) SELECT AVG(k.type_average) AS average_type_price, AVG(k.type_average - b.overall_average) AS average_above_baseline, AVG(k.type_average - m.average_kept_type) AS average_above_kept_mean FROM baseline b CROSS JOIN kept_mean m LEFT JOIN kept_types k ON k.type_average > m.average_kept_type GROUP BY b.overall_average;
